title: 3Sum Target Sum - Solution
approach: Sort + 3 pointers nested (1 loop and 1 two-pointer search).
intuition: Given an integer array nums, return all the unique triplets [nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]] such that their sum equals 0.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Sort + 3 pointers nested (1 loop and 1 two-pointer search).
space_complexity: O(log n) to O(n) for sorting
common_mistakes: Sort the array first, then use two pointers inside a loop.
Skip duplicates to avoid duplicate triplets.
